name: 调研报告
description: 把一个问题拆成子问题，收集资料，写成带引用的报告，再用脚本检查每个结论有没有出处。 / Break a question into parts, gather sources, write a cited report, then check that every claim has a source.

topic.description: 调研题目，例如：为什么猫喜欢纸箱 / The question, e.g. why cats like boxes

audience.description: 写给谁看 / Who will read it

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 子问题
stages.description: 把题目拆成 3 到 6 个要回答的子问题。 / Split the topic into 3 to 6 sub-questions to answer.

stages.name: 资料
stages.description: 每个来源一个 Markdown：开头写标题和链接。 / One Markdown file per source, starting with its title and link.

executor.instructions: 把资料放进 sources/，一个来源一个 .md 文件，开头写标题和链接。模板里有 3 份自己写的示例，用之前换成你的笔记。 / Put sources in sources/, one .md file each, starting with a title and a link. The template has 3 short samples written for it; replace them with your own notes.

stages.name: 提纲
stages.description: 每节标出回答哪个子问题、用哪些来源。 / Each section notes which sub-question it answers and which sources it uses.

stages.name: 报告
stages.description: 写成报告，每个结论后面用 [来源文件名] 标出处。 / Write the report, with [source file name] after each claim.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 找出不存在的引用、没被引用的来源、没被回答的子问题，以及没有出处的段落。 / Find citations of missing sources, sources never cited, unanswered sub-questions, and paragraphs with no citation.
